DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast tumor (superior sulcus tumor).

The CT results indicate a solid mass at the apex of your right lung, which is compressing the brachial plexus and causing your arm weakness, pain, and sensory loss. This explains your symptoms and the weight loss; the suggestion of Multiple Sclerosis is incorrect given these specific findings.
